t: There is authorized to be appropriated to the General Services Administration, the sum of $750,000 for planning, design, construction, and costs incidental thereto, including the cost of initial furnishings.

fable.w: This section only authorizes an appropriation to a federal agency (the General Services Administration) for planning, design, construction, and furnishings. There is no tempting reading here: it mentions no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government is involved in any decision.
fable.s: There is authorized to be appropriated to the General Services Administration, the sum of $750,000 for planning, design, construction, and costs incidental thereto, including the cost of initial furnishings.
